regime_context: Detector shows a bifurcated China A-shares tape: Coal leads the momentum rank (0.735) but is NOT trend-gate eligible and has weak durability (0.25), while Banks are the only eligible theme (trend-gate passed) with high durability (0.8) and strong breadth (0.833) but are crowded (z=1.77). The one validated edge (absolute-trend gate) did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so all leans must be treated as low-conviction directional judgement, not edge extraction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the leadership handoff from Coal to Banks CONFIRMS: if Banks (512800.SS) closes above Coal (515220.SS) on a 10-day cumulative return basis while both are positive, the handoff is real and Coal's rank lead retires as a signal. Until that condition prints, treat Coal's lead as a momentum residual and Banks' durability as the operative theme.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the ONLY theme passing the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) with high durability (0.8, hurst=trend) and strong breadth (0.833) — the structural legs that matter most on a mean-reverting tape where the gate whipsaws otherwise. The crowding flag (z=1.77) is a sizing caution, not a fade; I deliberately do not treat the rank lead as a buy signal since rank-IC is ~0. This is a durability-and-breadth lean, expressed as a conditional.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and rank second to Coal on momentum; if the trend-gate did not reduce drawdown historically on this market, passing it offers no validated edge, and crowding could mark a local top rather than a durable trend.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) closes below its 20-day simple moving average before 2026-12-03 and fails to reclaim it within 5 trading days

theses.subject: Coal

On this market where the gate already failed to hold, following the raw rank leader without gate support is a low-quality lean; I express this as avoidance, not a short.
